Path: studio — a read-only package offers no edit it will throw away | 缺项 (on a read-only package the Automations pillar's header "Enabled" switch and the flow node inspector ignore `readOnly`: the switch saves a refused draft and keeps its wrong state, and inspector edits are silently discarded) | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Direction: thread the pillar's real `readOnly` flag, as objectui#2259 did for the Data pillar, and roll back a refused toggle

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`AutomationsPillar`) ⇒ `domain:ui`. It is a finding of acceptance run objectstack-ai/objectstack#20674 (card objectstack-ai/objectstack#12438).

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-29T17:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** The server gate holds: the metadata was byte-identical before and after. But an author's edits on the Studio path are silently lost, and the switch shows a state the server never accepted. It runs, but wrongly, on the authoring road.

**Direction.**
- **The switch.** The header "Enabled" switch takes `readOnly` (disabled, or absent) on a read-only package.
- **The inspector.** The flow inspector is created with the pillar's real `readOnly` flag instead of the hardcoded `false`, exactly the way the Data pillar threads it (objectui#2259). ⛔ No second read-only mechanism.
- **Roll back a refusal.** `toggleEnabled` rolls its optimistic draft back when the save is refused, so the switch never shows a state the server refused. That holds on any package, read-only or not.
- **Pins:**
  - On a read-only package, the switch is disabled and the inspector's inputs are read-only.
  - A refused toggle returns the switch to the server's state.
  - On a writable package, both still edit (the control).

  - The header switch (`:4116-4117`, `disabled={!isEditable || !!saving}`) also takes `readOnly`.
  - The flow inspector (`:4253-4263`, `readOnly: false`) gets the pillar's real flag, as the Data pillar's inspector does at `:3753`. `FlowNodeInspector` / `FlowEdgeInspector` already disable on `readOnly`, so no inspector file moves.
  - `toggleEnabled` (`:4075-4092`) rolls its optimistic draft back when the save is refused.
- Pins:
  - On a read-only package the switch is disabled and the inspector's inputs are disabled.
  - A refused toggle returns the switch to the server's state.
  - On a writable package both still edit (the control).
- One changeset.
Stop on breach; explain in the report.

Clause-②: no
Why no: a courtesy gate the pillar already documents is applied to two more controls. No schema, prop, type or accepted set moves.

Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-29T18:06Z at objectui `origin/main` `8a5ae3d63`. No open PR touches `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`.
